header: Load a piece of the page only when it is needed: this is the one place for the two small tools every lazy piece uses, so that no file writes them again.

- lazyComponent(loader, "Name"): a component whose code is fetched the first time it is drawn (never on the server: these are windows that open after a click). The loader is the file's own `() => import("...")`, which the caller keeps so that it can ALSO call it ahead of time to warm the browser's cache (the same call returns the same, already fetched, file).
- whenIdle(fn): runs fn once the browser has nothing better to do (or after a short wait where it has no idle callback), and returns the function that cancels it.

Used by src/components/TopBar.tsx (the search window and the guide), src/components/managementPanels.ts (the management pages) and src/components/PeopleAndEvents.tsx (the calendar, the confetti). I choose when each is fetched in src/lib/perf/switches.js.

symbols.name: PreloadWhen
doc: When a lazy piece is fetched besides "when it is first drawn": "pointer" = no earlier than that (the caller warms it itself, e.g. when the pointer reaches a button), "idle" = once the browser is idle, "now" = as soon as this file is loaded.

symbols.name: lazyComponent
symbols.sig: export function lazyComponent<M extends Record<string, unknown>, K extends keyof M & string>(load: () => Promise<M>, name: K, preload: PreloadWhen = "pointer")
symbols.generics: M extends Record<string, unknown>, K extends keyof M & string
doc: A component of a file, loaded on first use (the file is named by its loader, the component by its export name; "default" for a default export) and, if asked, fetched ahead (`preload`; the values come from src/lib/perf/switches.js).

symbols.name: whenIdle
symbols.sig: export function whenIdle(fn: () => void, maxWaitMs = 4000): () => void
doc: Runs fn when the browser is idle (at the latest after `maxWaitMs`); the returned function cancels it.
